description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for configuration properties related to file-based device registry implementations in the Eclipse Hono project. It includes configurable parameters such as file name, cache age, persistence options, and modification permissions.

classes.name: AbstractFileBasedRegistryConfigProperties
classes.description: An abstract class for configuring file-based device registry properties such as file name, cache settings, and modification permissions.

methods.name: getDefaultFileName
methods.description: An abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to specify the default filename for the registry persistence.

methods.name: setCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Sets the maximum cache age in seconds; throws IllegalArgumentException if the value is negative.

methods.name: getCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Retrieves the current maximum cache age setting.

methods.name: isSaveToFile
methods.description: Returns whether the registry content is set to be periodically saved to file.

methods.name: setSaveToFile
methods.description: Enables or disables periodic saving of the registry content to file.

methods.name: isModificationEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether modification of registry entries is allowed.

methods.name: setModificationEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables modification permissions on the registry.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the file path used for registry persistence.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the file path for registry persistence.

methods.name: isStartEmpty
methods.description: Indicates whether the registry should start empty, ignoring any existing JSON files.

methods.name: setStartEmpty
methods.description: Sets whether to ignore existing JSON files and start with an empty registry.

calls: throw new IllegalArgumentException("max age must be >= 0")
